These printed file names will be used next with the Image_Analyzer tool to extract RMS roughness (Rq) values.</thought>
<action>Code_Executor</action>
<action_input>{"code":"import nanosurf, time, os, glob, math

spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan
opmode = app.OperatingMode

# Set tapping (PhaseContrast) mode to protect the tip
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Use a consistent filename mask for the scans
app.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask('area_scan')

# Define scan areas (m^2) – 1, 4, 9, 16 µm^2
areas = [1e-12, 4e-12, 9e-12, 16e-12]
for A in areas:
    width = math.sqrt(A)  # side length in meters
    # Configure scan geometry
    scan.ImageWidth = width
    scan.ImageHeight = width
    scan.Points = 256
    scan.Lines = 256
    scan.Scantime = 0.55  # seconds per line (adjustable)
    # Start the scan (upward direction)
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    # Wait until the scan finishes
    while scan.IsScanning:
        time.sleep(1)
    # Identify the most recent .nid file generated by this scan
    nid_files = glob.glob('*.nid')
    if nid_files:
        latest = max(nid_files, key=os.path.getmtime)
        print(f'AREA {A:.2e} FILE {latest}')
    else:
        print(f'AREA {A:.2e} FILE NOT_FOUND')

del spm"}>
